item.content:encoded: For me, the best part of From Soft games is the level design. The lore, the art, the atmosphere… the way places twist and turn on themselves… the way loot is used like breadcrumbs, enticing you across rooftops and down creaky rafters… the grand reveals where you see a place you were previously, now in the distance... or where you arrive, unexpectedly, in a place you were trying to reach forever.
